name: Gubbarewala: The Flying Balloons
competency: Understanding subtraction as take-away, counting remaining objects, and solving basic subtraction equations
ncertStandard: Grade 1 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 5 (How Many Left? Subtraction)
overview: At the lively village fair, Kaka the balloon seller has bunches of bright, smiling balloons. When a playful breeze blows, children tap balloons to let them soar into the clouds, count the balloons still in Kaka's hand, and discover subtraction naturally through concrete visual action.
learningOutcomes: Connect physical removal of objects with subtraction
Count remaining objects one-by-one to verify differences
Translate visual situations into mathematical equations (A - B = C)
Build early subtraction fluency within 5, 10, and up to 15

levels.name: Little Balloon Helper
levels.description: Basic subtraction with up to 5 balloons. Take away 1 or 2 balloons.

levels.name: Fairground Friend
levels.description: Subtraction with up to 8 balloons. Multiple color variations.

levels.name: Mela Champion
levels.description: Subtraction with up to 10 balloons. Equations with larger differences.

levels.name: Sky Detective
levels.description: Missing subtrahend challenges: how many balloons flew away? (A - ? = C)

levels.name: Grand Balloon Party
levels.description: Fluency challenges with up to 15 balloons for growing mathematicians.
